rationale_text: Case 10473_1000481: a 3.49 cc lesion in the transition zone is moderately hypointense on T2W (z=-0.82 relative to same-zone background tissue) with round to oval, more circumscribed (sphericity=0.63) margins. A substantial portion of the lesion falls outside the automated whole-gland segmentation, suggestive of extraprostatic extension (note: the gland mask is AI-derived and not verified at the capsule boundary, so this may partly reflect gland-segmentation imprecision rather than confirmed extension). These measurements are consistent with PI-RADS category 5.
